description: Waits for a new message to arrive and returns it in full. Use it right after signing up somewhere to catch a verification code or link. Only mail that arrives after the call starts counts, unless after_message_id is given.

after_message_id.description: Count mail after this message instead of from now.

from_contains.description: Only mail whose sender contains this, like "github.com".

subject_contains.description: Only mail whose subject contains this.

name: wait_for_message
title: Wait for a message
